news.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie Tops April 2026 Anticipation Charts
news.summary: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is the most anticipated film of April 2026, with over 983 million attention signals recorded. Brie Larson and Benny Safdie have joined the voice cast for Universal's animated feature, arriving in theatres this month.

news.title: Michael Jackson Biopic 'Michael' Eyes $150M Global Opening — Releasing April 24
news.summary: Antoine Fuqua's Michael, starring Jaafar Jackson as Michael Jackson, releases theatrically on April 24, 2026. The biopic had initially been slated for 2025 but required a major overhaul. It is now eyeing $150 million in global ticket sales.

news.title: 'The Drama' — Zendaya and Robert Pattinson Star in Pre-Wedding Thriller
news.summary: The Drama follows bookstore clerk Emma Harwood (Zendaya) and British museum director Charlie Thompson (Robert Pattinson), a couple days away from marriage who discover unsettling truths about each other, upending their relationship.

news.title: CinemaCon 2026: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Unveils Trojan Horse Footage and Charlize Theron's Calypso
news.summary: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey made a massive splash at CinemaCon 2026 at Caesar's Palace, with new Trojan horse footage unveiled alongside a first look at Charlize Theron as Calypso. Jerry Bruckheimer also announced a musical adaptation of Homer's The Odyssey called 'Epic', partnering with Jorge Rivera-Herrans.

news.title: 'Marty Supreme' — Oscar Best Picture Nominee Comes to HBO Max on April 24
news.summary: Marty Supreme, nominated for Best Picture at the 2026 Academy Awards, arrives on HBO Max on April 24, 2026, expanding its reach after a successful theatrical run.

news.title: 'The Mummy' Reimagining by Lee Cronin Released April 17
news.summary: Lee Cronin's supernatural horror reimagining of The Mummy, starring Jack Reynor and Laia Costa, was released on April 17, 2026, bringing a fresh take to the classic franchise.

news.title: Keanu Reeves Stars in Jonah Hill's 'Outcome' — Now Streaming on Apple TV+
news.summary: Outcome, directed and co-written by Jonah Hill, premiered on April 10, 2026 on Apple TV+. The film uses Keanu Reeves' charismatic star power for comedic commentary on fame and the artificial world of Hollywood.

news.title: Anne Hathaway's 'Mother Mary' — Psychological Thriller Musical Among April's Most Awaited
news.summary: Mother Mary, a psychological thriller musical starring Anne Hathaway, is among the most anticipated films of April 2026, drawing attention alongside Barbie Ferreira's horror remake Faces of Death and the Jason Segel–Samara Weaving comedy thriller Over Your Dead Body.

news.title: Netflix April 2026: Charlize Theron Australian Wilderness Thriller Drops April 24
news.summary: Netflix's April 2026 slate includes a thriller starring Charlize Theron alongside Taron Egerton and Eric Bana, following a grieving woman on a trek through the Australian wilderness, releasing April 24.

news.title: Jana Nayagan Online Leak Sparks CBFC Controversy; Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan Voice Support
news.summary: Thalapathy Vijay's final film Jana Nayagan suffered a significant online leak on April 10, 2026. CBFC denied involvement (April 11), calling claims baseless. KVN Productions initiated a forensic probe and cybercrime complaints. The release remains indefinitely delayed due to ongoing CBFC disputes. Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan publicly voiced support for the production team as of April 12, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Agrees to Thalapathy 70 with KVN Productions to Offset Piracy Losses
news.summary: Following the high-definition leak of Jana Nayagan, actor Vijay reportedly agreed to collaborate with KVN Productions for a new film tentatively titled Thalapathy 70. The decision, reported on April 18, aims to compensate the production house for financial losses caused by the piracy incident.

news.title: S.A. Chandrasekhar: CBFC Hurdles for Jana Nayagan Were Anticipated Before Shoot
news.summary: Veteran filmmaker S.A. Chandrasekhar stated in an interview (April 21, 2026) that the censorship challenges facing director H. Vinoth's Jana Nayagan were fully anticipated by Vijay and the team prior to production, as the project coincides with Vijay's transition into full-time politics ahead of the 2026 Tamil Nadu assembly elections.

news.title: Love Insurance Kompany (LIK) — Vignesh Shivan's Futuristic Romance Releases
news.summary: Love Insurance Kompany (LIK), directed by Vignesh Shivan, stars Pradeep Ranganathan and S.J. Suryah in a futuristic romantic comedy exploring love in a tech-driven world. Music is by Anirudh Ravichander.

news.title: Manithan Deivamagalam — Selvaraghavan in Gritty Crime Drama
news.summary: Manithan Deivamagalam stars Selvaraghavan in a powerful role as a crime drama exploring how an ordinary man becomes a symbol of hope amid crisis. Set in a rural backdrop with emotionally charged narrative.

news.title: Thaai Kizhavi OTT Release on Jio Hotstar — Rural Family Comedy
news.summary: Thaai Kizhavi, a feel-good comedy-drama blending rural humor with emotional storytelling and family traditions, premiered on Jio Hotstar this month.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, Kamal Haasan's Indian 3, Suriya's Karuppu Among Most Awaited Tamil Films of 2026
news.summary: Kollywood's most anticipated 2026 releases include Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, Kamal Haasan's Indian 3, Suriya's Karuppu and Suriya 46, Sivakarthikeyan's Parasakthi, Mookuthi Amman 2, and Marshal.

news.title: Kollywood Buzz: Carmeni Selvam, Nooru Saami, Kaattaan — New Announcements
news.summary: Fresh announcements in Kollywood include Carmeni Selvam, Nooru Saami, and Kaattaan among the latest projects announced, keeping the Tamil film industry pipeline busy for 2026.

news.title: Ramayana First Look: Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama — Diwali 2026 Release Set
news.summary: The first look teaser for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has been unveiled, introducing Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Sai Pallavi as Sita. Backed by Namit Malhotra, the film has a staggering $100 million (₹835 crore) budget — the costliest Indian film ever made. Part 1 releases Diwali 2026, Part 2 Diwali 2027.

news.title: Bhooth Bangla: Akshay Kumar–Priyadarshan Reunite After 14 Years — Horror Comedy Now in Theatres
news.summary: Bhooth Bangla, starring Akshay Kumar, Tabu, Paresh Rawal, and Rajpal Yadav, directed by Priyadarshan, marks the duo's reunion after 14 years. Paid previews began April 16, 2026. Produced by Balaji Motion Pictures and Cape of Good Films, set in a haunted mansion blending mythology, black magic, and comedy.

news.title: Chetak Screen Awards 2026: Dhurandhar Dominates with 14 Wins; Homebound Takes Best Film
news.summary: The Chetak Screen Awards 2026 honored the best of Indian cinema. Dhurandhar emerged as the biggest winner with 14 trophies across major categories, while Homebound secured the top prize for Best Film.

news.title: Ranbir Kapoor to Begin Shooting Dhoom 4 in April 2026
news.summary: Ranbir Kapoor is reported to start shooting for Dhoom 4 in April 2026, adding to his already packed slate that includes Ramayana and Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love and War.

news.title: 'Mrs. Kaptaan' Crime Thriller Web Series Premieres on Amazon MX Player
news.summary: Mrs. Kaptaan, a Hindi-language crime thriller web series starring Saqib Saleem, Siddharth Nigam, and Kavita Kaushik, directed by Jatin Wagle, premiered on Amazon MX Player on April 3, 2026.

news.title: April 2026 OTT Releases: Matka King, Toaster, Do Deewane Seher Mein and More
news.summary: A slate of OTT releases arrived on Hindi streaming platforms this week including Matka King, Toaster, and Do Deewane Seher Mein, offering fresh content to digital audiences.

news.title: 6 Hindi Films in Theatres April 2026: Bhooth Bangla, Ginny Weds Sunny 2, Mercy and More
news.summary: April 2026 brings six new Hindi theatrical releases including Akshay Kumar's Bhooth Bangla, the sequel Ginny Weds Sunny 2, and the drama Mercy, offering a varied cinematic spread to Hindi audiences this month.

news.title: NTR's 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel Set for June 25, 2026 PAN-India Release
news.summary: Jr NTR's highly anticipated collaboration with KGF director Prashanth Neel, titled Dragon, is confirmed for a PAN-India theatrical release on June 25, 2026. Filming is currently in progress.

news.title: Buzz: Allu Arjun Out, Jr NTR In for Trivikram's Mythological Film
news.summary: Massive industry buzz suggests Allu Arjun may be out of Trivikram Srinivas' upcoming mythological project with Jr NTR reportedly stepping in as a replacement, though official confirmations are pending.

news.title: Vaazha 2 Telugu Paid Premieres Announced Ahead of April 24 Release
news.summary: Vaazha 2 (Telugu), directed by Savin SA, is gearing up for a grand theatrical release on April 24, 2026. Paid premieres have been announced to build pre-release excitement.

news.title: Deepika Padukone's Role in Allu Arjun's 'Raaka' Not Reduced, Confirms Report
news.summary: Reports circulating about Deepika Padukone's role being trimmed in Allu Arjun's Raaka have been dismissed. Sources confirm her part remains intact in the upcoming big-budget Telugu action film.

news.title: Mrithyunjay Premieres on Netflix from April 3, 2026
news.summary: Telugu film Mrithyunjay made its OTT debut on Netflix on April 3, 2026, offering digital audiences a chance to catch the film after its theatrical run.

news.title: Aa Gang Repu 3 Series Streams on Aha from April 16, 2026
news.summary: The third installment of the popular Telugu series Aa Gang Repu started streaming on Aha from April 16, 2026, continuing the franchise's run on the Telugu-focused OTT platform.

news.title: Band Melam Confirmed for ZEE5 OTT Premiere on April 24, 2026
news.summary: Telugu film Band Melam is confirmed for its digital premiere on ZEE5 on April 24, 2026, joining the wave of recent Telugu OTT releases across major streaming platforms.

news.title: Tollywood 2026 Big Slate: Prabhas' Fouji, Ram Charan's Peddi, NTR's Dragon Lead the Line-Up
news.summary: 2026 is a landmark year for Tollywood with superstars Prabhas (Fouji), Ram Charan (Peddi), and Jr NTR (Dragon) all having major releases lined up, generating massive anticipation across the Telugu-speaking audience worldwide.

news.title: Vaazha 2 Enters ₹200 Crore Club in 17 Days — Among Fastest Malayalam Films
news.summary: Vaazha 2 has crossed the ₹200 crore worldwide mark within just 17 days of its release, placing it among the fastest Malayalam films to achieve this milestone — notably without a conventional star-led cast.

news.title: 'Patriot' — Most Expensive Malayalam Film Ever, Features Mohanlal–Mammootty Reunion After 14 Years
news.summary: Patriot has been billed as the most expensive Malayalam film ever made, with a budget exceeding ₹150 crore. The film features an ensemble cast marking the highly anticipated reunion of Mohanlal and Mammootty after 14 years.

news.title: Vishu Day: 'Oru Durooha Sahacharyathil' and 'Pallichattambi' Hit Theatres on April 15
news.summary: Two Malayalam films, Oru Durooha Sahacharyathil (starring Kunchacko Boban) and Pallichattambi (starring Tovino Thomas), were released in theatres on Vishu Day, April 15, 2026, adding to the festive box office celebrations in Kerala.

news.title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu Streams on JioHotstar from April 15 — Available in 5 Languages
news.summary: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu began streaming on JioHotstar on April 15, 2026. It is available in Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi, signaling the pan-India reach of recent Malayalam productions.

news.title: Drishyam 3, Patriot, I'm Game Lead High-Budget Mollywood Lineup for Rest of 2026
news.summary: Malayalam cinema is gearing up for a string of big-budget releases for the rest of 2026. Drishyam 3 (Mohanlal), Patriot, and I'm Game headline a slate where many films carry budgets between ₹10 crore and ₹150+ crore, reflecting the industry's growing ambitions.

news.title: Mollywood Box Office Boom: Aadu 3, Vaazha 2, Mohiniyattam Pack Theatres Across Kerala
news.summary: Malayalam cinema is in the midst of a cinematic boom with Aadu 3, Vaazha 2, and the celebrated Mohiniyattam all packing theatres across Kerala. The industry has seen a surge in high-budget productions and robust box office performance throughout early 2026.

news.title: Top OTT Picks This Weekend: Sambhavam, Haal and More for Malayalam Audiences
news.summary: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu and Haal are among the top OTT titles recommended for Malayalam cinema fans this weekend, as streaming platforms compete to offer the best of Mollywood's recent output.

news.title: Yash's 'Toxic' Teaser Released — Period Gangster Film Generates Massive Fan Excitement
news.summary: Yash's period gangster film Toxic has released its teaser, generating significant excitement among fans and the pan-India audience. The teaser signals a grand, high-octane production from the KGF star.

news.title: Rishab Shetty Teases a Big 2026 Announcement for Fans
news.summary: Kantara director and actor Rishab Shetty has teased a major announcement coming for his fans in 2026. While details remain under wraps, the news has generated considerable speculation within the Kannada film industry.

news.title: 'Second Case of Seetharam' Makes Digital Debut on Prime Video from April 17
news.summary: Second Case of Seetharam, starring Vijay Raghavendra, is a Kannada crime thriller that premiered on Prime Video on April 17, 2026. It is available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Hindi, broadening its audience reach.

news.title: Sandalwood 2026 Box Office: Love Mocktail 3 Leads with ₹9.50 Cr
news.summary: Sandalwood's top grossers of 2026 so far are Love Mocktail 3 (₹9.50 Cr), Landlord (₹6.91 Cr), Cult 2026 (₹3.57 Cr), and Rakkasapuradol (₹3.44 Cr), showcasing steady audience turnout for Kannada films.

news.title: Sandalwood Gears Up for Pan-India Ambitions and Large-Scale Productions in 2026
news.summary: The Kannada film industry is targeting a landmark year with ambitious large-scale productions, pan-India releases, and bold storytelling, reflecting Sandalwood's growing creative confidence and commercial strength.

news.title: Kannada OTT Roundup April 2026: New Movies Streaming on Prime Video, ZEE5, JioHotstar
news.summary: April 2026 brings a fresh wave of Kannada OTT releases across Prime Video, ZEE5, JioHotstar, Sun NXT, and SonyLIV, offering digital audiences a diverse lineup of new Sandalwood content throughout the month.
